Reaching the voyage of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the quill of a task receipt, and the pearl is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
